observations.body: The writer says God can act with great power yet orders all things by measure and shows mercy because all belong to God.
observations.label: God’s power is described through measure and mercy: action

observations.body: Creatures are described as small before God and corrected little by little so they may turn from wickedness.
observations.label: God’s power is described through measure and mercy: response

observations.body: measure · mercy on all · lover of souls · correct little by little

payload.posture: Read Wisdom 11:21–12:2 as judgment, exile, and the nations evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage explains mercy through ownership and love of life without claiming that correction is painless.
payload.title: God’s power is described through measure and mercy
